title: Restart the canopy
story: Recovery phase two. The relay is installed. Replay the scheduler tape and emit safe commands to restore the canopy.
lesson: A fault latches the system offline until RESET. A reset emits HOLD. Dry and wet readings control water only while online.
objective: FAULT -> VENT and latch. RESET -> HOLD and clear latch. While latched emit HOLD for other events. Otherwise DRY -> PUMP; all others -> HOLD.
hint: Maintain a latched flag. Handle FAULT and RESET before evaluating DRY.
